_comment: The Trench Dispatch, held as a GitHub release asset rather than in git history.
Fetch it with: npm run rules:pdfs
The PDF is gitignored; its extracted text is committed, and that text is what
the pipeline reads. The sha256 is the release asset digest.
One thing the extract CANNOT carry: the currency glyphs. The Dispatch draws
them from a Type3 font and they are not in the PDF's text stream at all, so
every extractor yields a bare number — pdf-parse and PyMuPDF alike. A cost in
this document therefore has to be read from the RENDERED page: a crown in a
filled disc is Ducats, an eight-pointed sun in an outlined disc is Glory. Ops
whose currency was read that way say so in _costCurrencyConfirmed.

release.note: Private repo — the public releases/download URL 404s. Fetch via the authenticated api.github.com asset endpoint; see scripts/rules-fetch-pdfs.mjs.

assets.role: Trench Dispatch 01 (April 2026): errata, the Grail Strains and Amalgam rewrite, the Vile Corpus, two new Glory Items and the Mercenary section. Mostly Public Beta.
